:::caution[deprecated]

This endpoint has been deprecated and may be replaced or removed in future versions of the API.

:::

**Deprecated** (ADR 0019): reads the local copy of dock-scheduling's
inbound appointments; read dock-scheduling instead. Lists appointments
in ascending `windowStart` order (ties by id), a page at a time.
`door` and `state` narrow by equality; `from` and `to` narrow to
appointments whose window overlaps `[from, to)`. The copy only moves
through `Booked` and `Cancelled` (a legacy row may still show
`CheckedIn` or `Completed`).
